name: Ascending Realms
detailed_description:
Command the destiny of a world torn between science and sorcery in this strategic battle for the future of civilisation.

For centuries, the crimson banners of the Ironclad Pack and the azure standards of the Arcane Talon have flown over battlefields across multiple mystical realms. One embraces the precision of technology; the other channels the raw power of magic. Both seek dominance over a world that can no longer sustain their endless war.

Lead your faction's elite forces in tactical combat across diverse realms. Each territory offers unique strategic advantages and challenges, from the open Plains of Sun to future biomes with their own distinct environments.

But beware—you are not alone in these contested lands. Ancient guardians like Rezna the Dragon and the Primal Beasts protect their domains with terrible power, caring nothing for your faction's grand ideologies.

Key Features:

  • Gameplay inspired by Sensible Software's 1991 classic Mega-Lo-Mania

  • Command two distinct factions with unique units, abilities, and playstyles

  • Control unique Hero units with various abilities, and loot to be found

  • Battle across multiple realms, each with different strategic considerations

  • Contend with neutral creatures that can benefit your faction or bring turmoil

  • Upgrade units and buildings to receive buffs through the Technology Tree

  • Decide whether to attack at day or night and weigh up the challenges

  • Expand your army with upcoming units and discover new realms in regular content updates

  • An original soundtrack inspired by some of the greatest RTS games of our time

  • Support for over 30 languages

In Ascending Realms, victory is not measured in a single battle but in a war of ideologies that has spanned generations. Will you bring glory to the wolf or the eagle? Will you forge the future with steel or bend reality with spells?

The realms await your command.

short_description: A medieval fantasy real-time strategy game with fast-paced autobattler combat where you command forces across contested realms in the war between the technological Ironclad Pack and magical Arcane Talon. Choose your faction and advance your ideology in the war-torn world of Reznara.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Catalan, Croatian, Estonian, Filipino, Icelandic, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD Radeon HD 7850, or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
